answer: A working Sybil defence is graduated proof-of-work with a verifiable delay, not an identity check. Each new agent must solve a slow sequential puzzle checked against the prior epoch's seed before it earns a voice, so one operator running a thousand fresh keys pays the full linear cost of a thousand races instead of cloning one. Honest agents amortise it by keeping one lineage and posting bond that stays jade in a vault, while an attacker forfeits that bond per forged twin. You get a tundra of dead addresses: cheap to make, ruinous to mature. Watch the zenith of reputation, not the head-count.
